title: Constant derived unit under identity inverse image
statement: For any commutative ring A and scheme S, the constant derived-unit comparison ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (identity S) of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] equals the component at that unit of affineLinearPullbackId A S of [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action]. No Noetherian, finite-coefficient, or invertibility hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Prove the identity constant-sheaf comparison for a general Grothendieck abelian coefficient category. Apply the hom-equivalence of the constant-sheaf adjunction composed with identity inverse image and transported along the terminal-sections isomorphism. The left-adjoint uniqueness equation and upperStarId_hom_app_unit_app reduce equality to the terminal pullback identity; terminalIsTerminal.hom_ext identifies its canonical isomorphisms. This is the existing ConstantPullbackIdentityCoherence proof with general coefficients.

proof.text: Apply SheafExactDegreeZero.unit_id to an arbitrary exact additive endofunctor F and an isomorphism F≅id. Its inverse-map equality gives equality of isomorphisms by Iso.ext_inv. Taking hom yields exact single-complex identity coherence, including the specified mapDerivedCategoryIdIso.

Expand ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback and affineLinearPullbackId, and the definition of singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso. Substitute the constant-sheaf identity and the exact single-complex identity. The two composites now have the same left-derived/exact comparison and agree definitionally.

lean.statement:
theorem vectorIntegration_identity_unit (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (𝟙 S)).hom =
      (affineLinearPullbackId A S).hom.app (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)
